services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Evie Parent has been a Twisters athlete for 10 years and competed on our competitive team for the last 9 years. She started at a Level 3 and finished off her senior year competing at the Xcel Platinum Level where she placed 5th all around at her last Massachusetts USAG States competition. Evie's love for the sport of gymnastics naturally evolved into coaching. She has been coaching for Twisters for 4 years and has experience teaching our pre-k, recreational, and tumbling classes as well as coaching Levels 1-3 and Xcel Bronze and Silver. Evie is a USAG Certified Coach as well as being Safe Sport Certified through USAG. Evie is available to teach private lessons and is eager to help students
